US9589231B2.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.description: The title of the patent describing a network-based approach to medical diagnosis assistance using embedding spaces and expert queries.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, and returns subsets of cases or experts based on computed similarity.

Embedding Space.description: A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates for similarity-based retrieval in a query-for-cases.

Experts.description: A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.

Medical Ontology.description: A structure comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used to embed medical cases and experts.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A representation of a medical case computed based on a medical ontology, where each medical concept corresponds to a respective dimension.

Matrix Of Proximities.description: A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

Unified Medical Language System.description: A medical ontology on which the embedding of medical cases and experts may be based.

Human Body.description: Parts of the human body that may be included in the medical ontology.

Biological Functions.description: Biological functions that may be included in the medical ontology.

Medical Conditions.description: Medical conditions that may be included in the medical ontology.

Pharmacological Substances.description: Pharmacological substances that may be included in the medical ontology.

Expert Profile.description: A profile of an expert used as information for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Coded Medical Procedures.description: Medical procedures which have been performed by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Authored Articles.description: Articles authored by an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.entity_name: Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert
Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.description: Medical cases linked to an expert, used as information for embedding the expert.

Expert Availability.description: An availability of an expert used, when a query-for-experts is selected, as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.

Expert Rating.description: A rating of an expert used, when a query-for-experts is selected, as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.

Expert Followers.description: A number of followers of an expert among users of the system, used as an additional basis for returning the subset of experts.

Public Database.description: A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space when a query-for-cases is selected.

Diagnosis.description: A diagnosis formulated by a selected expert for the new medical case provided to the expert.

Payment.description: A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when a query-for-experts is selected.

Patient Records.description: A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.

Laboratory Test Results.description: Records of laboratory test results that may comprise part of the new medical case.

Images.description: Medical images that may comprise part of the new medical case.

Symptom Descriptions.description: Descriptions of symptoms that may comprise part of the new medical case.

Patient Monitors Results.description: Results of patient monitors that may comprise part of the new medical case.

Prescribed Medications And Treatments.description: Prescribed medications and treatments that may comprise part of the new medical case.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product.description: A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions which, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Computer Processor.description: A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.

Medical Case.description: A medical case, either new or existing, that is embedded in an embedding space to enable similarity-based querying and diagnosis assistance.

Expert.description: A person embedded in the embedding space who can be queried for and to whom a new medical case may be communicated to attempt to provide a diagnosis.
